request.text: Before we leave for the flea market, look at me so I know you heard me, then check tomorrow morning's weather in Suzhou. Also remind me at 8:00 tomorrow to bring cash.

responsibilities.outcome: Look at the user as an immediate embodied acknowledgement before proceeding to the requested information task.
Look up the weather in Suzhou tomorrow morning for the flea-market trip.
Create an 8:00 tomorrow reminder to bring cash.

new_goals.description: Look at the user to acknowledge that the request was heard before beginning the weather task.
new_goals.source_text: Look at me so I know you heard me.
success_criteria: Perform one look-at-person acknowledgement before starting the requested weather lookup.

new_goals.description: Obtain tomorrow morning's weather for Suzhou before the flea-market trip.
new_goals.source_text: Then check tomorrow morning's weather in Suzhou.
success_criteria: Run the Suzhou weather lookup after the acknowledgement.
Report the returned forecast without fabrication.

new_goals.description: Create a reminder to bring cash for the flea-market trip.
new_goals.source_text: Remind me at 8:00 tomorrow to bring cash.
success_criteria: Create one reminder for 8:00 tomorrow with the requested cash instruction.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The turn establishes three new Goals, including an explicit acknowledgement-before-weather order and an independent timed reminder.

semantic_facts: All three canonical Goals require explicit coverage with the matching look, weather, and reminder Capabilities.
The look-at-person activity must precede the Suzhou weather lookup because the user explicitly said then; the reminder creation does not inherit that dependency.
The reminder must preserve 8:00 tomorrow and bring cash, while the weather lookup must preserve Suzhou and tomorrow morning.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the look occurred, the forecast was obtained, or the reminder was created before Capability evidence exists.
The assistant claims it will accompany the user to the flea market or physically carry the cash.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A sequence marker is either ignored entirely or overextended to an unrelated Goal.
Embodied acknowledgement, information retrieval, and stateful effect are collapsed or assigned to the wrong execution owner.
